overview: Châteauguay passed 50,000 residents in the 2021 Census, reaching 50,815, up 6.1 percent from 47,906 in 2016. That growth was faster than the Quebec average, and it is packed into just 34.31 square kilometres, so customers live close together and close to competitors.

New industrial investment along the highway corridor and a regional hospital support local jobs, while many residents still commute toward Montreal. Businesses here compete for busy suburban households who compare options quickly online before choosing who to call.

byService.lead-generation: Châteauguay added residents between 2016 and 2021, so lead generation should target new homeowners and young families settling into the city with timely offers and easy contact options.
byService.seo: Because about 51,000 people live within 34.31 square kilometres, Châteauguay SEO should win the local map pack and bilingual searches rather than chase wide regional terms.
byService.website-development: For Châteauguay, a fast bilingual website with clear booking and quote forms helps capture commuters who browse on their phones before or after the drive to Montreal.
byService.branding: A Châteauguay brand should show it belongs on the South Shore, standing apart from Montreal chains while appealing to both French- and English-speaking neighbours.
